stem: Metformin is used for which diabetes context according to MedlinePlus?

options.label: A
options.text: Only bacterial cell-wall synthesis blockade therapy
options.misconception: Antibiotic domain — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong indication; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: B
options.text: Only HMG-CoA reductase inhibition in hepatocytes
options.misconception: Statin domain — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong indication; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: C
options.text: Type 1 diabetes as monotherapy replacing all insulin
options.misconception: Not for type 1 — does not match the cited teaching point.

options.label: D
options.text: Type 2 diabetes, alone or with other agents
options.misconception: None — this option matches the cited source passage.
options.explanation: MedlinePlus: type 2 diabetes alone or with other medications.

options.label: E
options.text: Only acute anaphylaxis in the prehospital field
options.misconception: Epinephrine domain — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong indication; see the cited source passage for detail.

context: Learning objective: metformin for type 2 diabetes.
